snippet.title: Return to Long Shadows for the ZX Spectrum (quick demo)
snippet.description: Return to Long Shadows for the ZX Spectrum (quick demo). I wrote this game myself. It's a been a labour of love! It's a fantasy role-playing game for one to three players. Copies of this game can be downloaded/purchased at itch.io - https://martin-page.itch.io/return-to-long-shadows
